title: Vanishing Gowers norm forces vanishing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $k\ge 2$, and let $f:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\mathbb R$. If the Gowers norm of order $k$ of $f$ is zero, then $f$ is identically zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $(\mathbb F_2)^n$
The Gowers norm of order $k$ of $f$ equals zero
